appel.aucune_saisie: No entry for this session yet.

coquille.annee.appareil: The choice applies to this device and reloads the context. The server never keeps it.
coquille.aucune_capacite.texte: You are signed in. The school administrator needs to assign your areas so that your space can be built.
coquille.aucune_capacite.titre: Your account has no area yet
coquille.etablissement.rattaches: Those your account belongs to, and only those. Changing reloads the context.
demo.alerte_attente_corps: The text credit has run out. Messages are kept and will go out once topped up.
demo.alerte_danger_corps: The family has not been reached yet.
demo.alerte_info_corps: One class per page, with tick boxes.
demo.alerte_info_titre: The {heure} roll call can be printed in advance
demo.assistance_raison: Assistance is suspended for the school: the administrator can restore it.
demo.erreur_effectif: The count exceeds the {n} enrolled pupils: enter a number from 0 to {n}.
demo.impaye_reserve: overdue fees are one of only two red states
demo.mode_auto: By width: cards below 768 px, rows above
demo.motif_aide: A fact, not a judgement. Visible to the family once saved.
demo.raison_selection: No pupil selected: select at least one to save.
demo.recu_sms: Text the receipt to the family
demo.stable: steady since the start of term
domaine.a_venir: This area’s screen arrives with its own slice.
recherche.elargir: You can widen the search to the whole school.
ruban.conservees: {n} entries kept, sent once back online
ruban.conservees.un: One entry kept, sent once back online
ruban.rien_perdu: Keep going, nothing will be lost
session.activation.deux_facons_corps: Enter your number to get a code: holding the number is the proof, whatever the channel. Or ask your school office for a new link.
session.activation.invalide.corps: An activation link works once and lasts seven days. Nothing is lost: your account activates just as well with a code received by SMS.
session.activation.numero: Enter my number and get a code
session.activation.secretariat: Or ask your school office for a new link.
session.choix.partage: This number is shared in your family. Each of you has an account, children and messages; the choice is recorded with the sign-in.
session.choix.un_seul_sms: A single SMS was sent for these accounts.
session.code.aide: Six digits. The code is valid for ten minutes.
session.code.epuise: Five wrong codes: this code is destroyed
session.code.epuise_corps: Get a new code and enter it in full. Your account is not blocked.
session.code.expire_corps: A code is valid for ten minutes. Get a new one: the SMS is free and the last code no longer counts.
session.code.format: The code has six digits: enter them all.
session.code.pas_arrive.corps: The number your school registered for you may be a different one. Ask the school office to check it.
session.code.pas_arrive.titre: The SMS has not arrived yet?
session.code.tarde: The SMS can take up to two minutes to arrive. You can close the app: the code stays valid for ten minutes.
session.code.tentatives_restantes: That code is not right: {n} attempts left. Check the latest SMS.
session.code.tentatives_restantes.un: That code is not right: one attempt left. Check the latest SMS.
session.code.trop_de_demandes: Too many requests for this number
session.code.trop_de_demandes_corps: You can try again in {duree}. The last code received is still valid for ten minutes: enter it.
session.numero.aide: The number the school office registered for you. No email address needed.
session.numero.format: This number is not complete: enter all of its digits, after the dialling code.
session.numero.sms_gratuit: The SMS is free. No data plan is needed to receive it.
session.numero.sous_titre: Marks, absences, payments and messages from the school, on your phone.
session.ouverture.aide: Four digits. No SMS is sent.
session.ouverture.faux: That code is not right: {n} attempts left. After that, an SMS will be needed.
session.ouverture.faux.un: That code is not right: one attempt left. After that, an SMS will be needed.
session.ouverture.inconnu: This phone no longer knows your account
session.ouverture.inconnu_corps: Enter your number: a code by SMS reopens your space, and you will choose a new personal code.
session.ouverture.instant: One moment: this phone may already know your account.
session.ouverture.oublie: Forgot your code? Get a code by SMS
session.ouverture.poste: Several accounts know this phone. Each one opens only with its own personal code.
session.ouverture.verrou: Personal code locked after five attempts
session.ouverture.verrou_corps: Get a code by SMS to reopen your space; you will then be able to choose a new personal code.
session.pin.courant_faux: Your current personal code is required to change it: enter it, or start a session by SMS to choose a new one.
session.pin.differents: The two codes differ: enter the same code twice.
session.pin.format: A personal code has four digits: enter all of them.
session.pin.pourquoi: It replaces the SMS each time you open the app on this phone: no more waiting for a message to take attendance or check marks. Do not share it.
session.reprise.corps: One moment. Nothing will be lost.
session.revoquee.corps: Start a new session: enter your number and you will get a code by SMS.
session.suspendu.corps: Your school administrator can reopen it. The school office will tell you who to contact.
session.telephone.action: Get the code on the new number
session.telephone.actuel_informe: It will be told about the change by SMS, and it opens your space until the new one is verified.
session.telephone.aide: A code will be sent to this new number. Your current number stays valid until it is verified.
session.telephone.change_corps: You will now sign in with {numero}. Your session stays open, and the previous number received an information message.
session.telephone.code_aide: Six digits, ten minutes, five attempts: the same rules as when signing in.
session.telephone.code_faux: That code is not right: check the last SMS received on the new number.
session.telephone.code_mort: That code is no longer valid: go back to the number to get a new one.
session.telephone.code_titre: Enter the code received on the new number
session.telephone.deja_utilise: This number already identifies another account. A number shared within a family is declared at the school office, not from your space.
session.telephone.tarde: The SMS can take up to two minutes to arrive. Your current number stays the identifier until this code is verified.
style.intro: Fourteen components, each state in light and dark themes, side by side. A development page: it does not exist in the build.
